title: Scheduling production
intro: Cutting cannot begin until every production stage has an assigned owner. Assignment is recorded in the scheduler.

steps.title: Select the garment to plan
steps.body: Open Scheduler and select the garment (1), then select Create plan (2). Several garments may be selected together where they are to be assigned to the same workers.

steps.title: Review the production plan
steps.body: The plan dialog lists every stage the garment must pass through. Each stage requires an assigned worker (1) before the plan can be saved.

steps.title: Assign the stages and schedule
steps.body: Assign a worker to each stage. Sewing is assigned to a unit rather than to an individual (1). Once all stages carry an assignment, Schedule becomes available (2). On scheduling, the garment advances to cutting.
